acceptance_evidence: AC1, a merged receipt with the wrong status is reported with both values: test_a_merged_receipt_with_a_status_of_doing_is_reported, and ten real cases this afternoon
AC2, a working stage saying done or todo is reported: two tests, one for each
AC3, SEEN-086 passes as the bootstrap: test_the_bootstrap_may_be_done_with_no_journal, and doctor on this tree says nothing about it
AC4, a delivered ticket awaiting merge may say review: test_a_delivered_receipt_not_yet_merged_may_say_review, which is this ticket's own state right now
AC5, nothing is repaired: test_the_check_repairs_nothing asserts the wrong status is still there afterwards

findings.claim: A plan revision in the working tree had reset eight delivered tickets to todo and renumbered over two merged ones
findings.failure_scenario: The backlog, the sprint report and every session read the status first. Eight tickets that had delivered would have read as unstarted, the sprint report would have shown 27 points as zero, and two merged tickets would have had their numbers reused by different work, with receipts and pull request bodies quoting the old meaning
findings.resolution: The check named all eight with the receipt commit proving each merged. The revision's two tickets are renumbered SEEN-096 and SEEN-097, its direction left untouched, and three sentences the code enforces are restored to CLAUDE.md. Recorded in the reconciliation commit and in the note at record 14

findings.claim: The test fixture's ticket said todo while the test started a journal
findings.failure_scenario: Every test project tripped the new check, which is exactly the disagreement it reports, so ten tests failed on a fixture that did not behave like a real ticket
findings.resolution: The fixture says doing, as a started ticket does. The same class of fixture gap as the pre-commit hook in SEEN-090 and the skill in SEEN-092: a fixture that does not carry the controls cannot exercise them

findings.claim: Record 12 is a contrived check, run out of habit
findings.failure_scenario: A reader takes it as evidence of a failing test for this ticket
findings.resolution: Disowned in the note at record 14 and cited by nothing. Second in eleven tickets, after record 8 of SEEN-088, which is worth knowing as a rate

security_checklist: The check reads ticket frontmatter and journals, both already walked by other checks
No live marketplace host in any test file
No PII, no database, no agent action
